title: Heterogeneous Prompting and Execution Feedback for SWE Issue Test Generation and Selection
task: Generate, execution-repair and select SWE issue reproduction tests using Otter candidates, issue morphs/context masks, and Agentless candidate code patches.
input_setting: Issue report + old repository; create Otter test candidates, run on old code, use LLM critic and code context to repair up to 10 attempts, then select one by checking test against 5 normalized Agentless surrogate patches and patch coverage.
author_relationship_evidence: Paper §8 Data Availability links reference [2], the Zenodo record whose title matches the paper; it contains e-Otter++ test-prediction JSON files, large per-run archives, and supplementary materials. IBM benchmark repository matches TDD-Bench dependencies but contains benchmark/previous Otter output rather than custom e-Otter++ implementation.
source_commit_or_archive: Zenodo record 18169083 (published 2026-01-07); TDD-Bench-Verified main tree checked 2026-10-15.
license: Zenodo artifact CC BY 4.0; paper CC BY 4.0. No e-Otter++ source code/license found. IBM TDD-Bench repository has its own LICENSE for the benchmark harness; that does not license the missing method implementation.
exact_models: GPT-4o snapshot gpt-4o-2024-08-06; Claude-3.7-Sonnet (paper does not give a dated snapshot identifier for every deployment); Mistral-Large 123B in supplementary experiments.
Test generation/morphs/masks and repair use hosted LLMs; critic at temperature 0, repair temperature 0.8.
weights_status: No model weights or fine-tuning; hosted closed-model APIs required for headline GPT-4o/Claude results. Agentless candidate patches were shared by Agentless authors rather than generated by the paper authors for these experiments.
evaluation_route: Paper-linked Zenodo provides prediction JSON, run ZIP archives, and supplementary PDF/spreadsheets; downloaded GPT-4o TDD output has 449 unique rows, matching benchmark, but GPT-4o SWT Lite JSON has only 272 unique rows vs 276 reported benchmark instances. Public IBM/TDD-Bench-Verified repo offers Docker evaluation harness and separate license. Static audit only; no code execution, benchmark evaluation or API calls.
blockers: The newly proposed e-Otter/e-Otter++ implementation source and executable prompts/selector code are not present in the linked Zenodo record or checked IBM benchmark repository; outputs/logs are public, but source-level exact reproduction is not established.

Headline models are hosted APIs; estimated paper cost is $1.80/instance for GPT-4o and $2.75/instance for Claude 3.7 with Agentless selection ($1.10/$1.70 excluding Agentless), too costly to rerun without separate approval. No calls were made.
SWT Lite GPT-4o prediction JSON has 272/276 rows, while paper reports 111/276; four cases are missing from the cached single-file output. TDD GPT-4o prediction file has all 449 rows.

Selection depends on 5 normalized Agentless patches per issue as surrogate fixes; their generation/source/config and exact reuse protocol are external dependencies. Paper notes these patches may be imperfect.
Results are model- and benchmark-specific; TDD-Bench Verified and SWT-Bench use different execution scopes (contributing test vs whole test file), so do not pool their scores.
Full setup still needs Otter generation and Docker benchmark harness, plus large archive handling.
concept_fit: High for execution-feedback oracle and test-selection analysis: critic checks issue-aligned failure, retrieved code repairs test, morphs/masks diversify hypotheses, surrogate patches provide an imperfect fix oracle. No explicit reusable concept representation.
recommendation: Very important related work and a strong benchmark comparator, but not a self-contained reproduction base: published result/log archives and official benchmark harness are public, while custom e-Otter++ source was not found. Use cached TDD predictions for later artifact validation if approved; before quantitative SWT comparison, reconcile 272/276 cached rows. Exact rerun would need reconstructing unpublished components or requesting/locating source and paying substantial closed-model API costs. Do not reimplement without user approval.
supporting_locations: Paper §§1–8 and Tables 1–14; full text cache SHA-256 b0fbab15f254a02e09fe268211f0127d53a86689dffba9d44e9de434ab93b294
papers/e-otter/public_evidence/source-audit.json records verified Zenodo downloads/checksums and row counts.
Downloaded files: public_evidence/gpt4o_e_otter_plus_tdd_verified.json (449 rows), gpt4o_e_otter_plus_swt_lite.json (272 rows), supplementary_material.zip (verified MD5).
Zenodo contains multiple multi-hundred-MB archives named e-otter_* / otter_* for generated runs/logs, but no implementation source in record file manifest.
